sources.entry: qpixel - Q&A-based community knowledge-sharing software. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Ruby

summary.one_liner: QPixel is a Rails-based Q&A community software package, the core platform behind codidact.com.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes QPixel as the Rails-based version of Codidact's core software for community knowledge-sharing. It supports multiple communities within a single installation, with multiple categories in each community and several post types (such as Q&A and Articles) within each category. Content is written in Markdown with live preview, and the README mentions MathJax support, image uploads, and custom content licenses. Voting sorts content by a score that accounts for controversy, and user abilities and privileges are tied to activity. The README says the project is under active development toward an MVP.
use_cases: community question and answer boards with voting
publishing articles and questions under custom licenses
how_to_run: See the Installation guide referenced in the README for a complete installation
notable: Multiple communities, each with categories and post types, in one installation
Voting with a score adjusted for controversy
Customizable content licenses and MathJax support
caveats: README says it is under active development toward MVP, so it may be unstable
Installation is only described by reference to a separate guide, with no quick-start in the README
